pronunciation_overrides.Tensorblue: tˈɛnsəɹblˌu (not in the misaki lexicon; accepted CTA)

lines.text: Two people tap Buy on the last seat at the same moment. Who gets it?
A careless app checks first, both see it free, and it sells twice.
A well-built system claims it in one step: only if it's still free.
The database runs the claims one at a time; the second finds it taken.
So one person gets the ticket, and the other sees "sold out".
Not every app does this, but the fix is simple: check and claim together.
